title: hctl seats configuration
description: Shape of the parsed .hctl/seats.toml. Schema validates single-object shape only (D-42); cross-field duties — pattern disjointness across seats/lanes, merge_coordinator existence and write_scope=canonical, branch owner uniqueness — belong to loader/doctor. This file is the single coordinator_config source (D-37): merge claims pin its {commit,path,blob}.

kernel.description: hctl version pin: exact semver or git OID; 'hctl@bootstrap' allowed pre-P1

merge_coordinator.description: The unique seat allowed to hold merge obligations (D-37); repo-wide merge_capacity is fixed at 1

enforcement.description: Replayable activation boundary (D-38): 'bootstrap' = level-4 trust, self-merge exception in force; 'active' = level-2 enforcement of gated .hctl/** changes; flipped only by a gated PR; doctor hard-checks

branch_pattern.description: Full refname pattern, git-refspec style, at most one '*'; no regex, no glob extensions

model.description: Attribution metadata only; never a routing key

capabilities.description: Planner hints; kernel only checks referential existence

author_concurrency.description: P1 admits only 0 (memo-only) or 1 (canonical); >1 requires a schema_version bump (D-44)

memo_branch_patterns.description: memo lane, canonical form refs/heads/memo/<seat>/* (D-08); must be disjoint from every author pattern (doctor)

coauthor_email.description: Optional stable GitHub App bot email for Co-authored-by trailers (attribution only; p1-attribution). Not an identity-hash or quorum input.

door_file.description: The file this harness auto-loads (D-25); one-line pointer to AGENTS.md
